title: BEGINNER LINE DANCE - COWBOY HUSTLE - TUTORIAL!

method.teacher_system: The teacher demonstrates and breaks down each section of the line dance facing away from the camera, explains weight placement and counts, combines the sections progressively, and finishes with a full run-through to music.
method.signature: Demonstrating the entire routine with the same orientation as the learner while maintaining clear, encouraging narration from start to finish.

practices.what: Starts by explaining weight distribution on the left foot and introduces the first step pattern with the right foot.
Counts out loud 1, 2, 3, 4 for the initial foot movement pattern.
Adds two heels forward and two toes back with the right foot following the initial steps.
Introduces alternating heels and toes in a sequence and then combines all heel and toe movements together.
Reviews the first part of the dance from the top before adding new movement.
Breaks down the next section featuring forward steps, kicks, and toe touches, repeating the cycle twice.
Puts together the first and second sections of the dance to ensure clarity.
Introduces the final section consisting of grapevines, breaking down the steps and adding a quarter turn.
Performs the entire cowboy hustle line dance from start to finish accompanied by country music.

adaptations.difficulty: the footwork sequence can feel challenging or fast
adaptations.adjustment: you can hop together and hop back, or you can take it easy and just step out and back

beliefs.belief: This line dance is versatile because it works with nearly any song at a country club and can be danced individually or in a group.

struggles.theme: feeling embarrassed or uncoordinated while trying to learn

clicked.theme: clear step-by-step instructions and facing the same direction

meant.theme: bringing back fond memories and providing accessible therapy or exercise

method.limits: The video does not show front-facing instruction of the full body steps during the breakdown, only back-facing and foot close-up views.
